contact.evidence_quote: Nature’s Way began in 1969 when our founder, Tom Murdock, sought a way to improve his wife Lavoli’s health. After trying conventional options without success, Tom turned to Native American herbalists to explore the traditional powers of plants. Lavoli’s health improved beyond all expectations (she lived another 25 years!), and Tom began his life’s quest to discover and share “Nature’s Way” to wellness.
